description: verification-architecture.md's purity-boundary map describes the mechanism by which `post_reel.py` imports the new shared `reel_verify.py` module as: 'via `sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))`-style import, matching its existing `cdp.py` import pattern'. This is factually wrong and self-contradictory once the two files' real locations are checked. Verified real paths: `post_reel.py` lives at `/Users/anicca/.claude/skills/ig-reels-poster/scripts/post_reel.py` (confirmed via `find` + `Read`); the new `reel_verify.py` is specified (both docs, consistently) to live at `~/anicca/skills/earn/clip/reel_verify.py` -- a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT directory tree, not a sibling of post_reel.py. `os.path.dirname(__file__)` from inside post_reel.py resolves to `~/.claude/skills/ig-reels-poster/scripts/` -- inserting THAT onto sys.path can never make `import reel_verify` succeed, since reel_verify.py does not live there. This directly contradicts the ACTUAL existing cdp.py import this same sentence claims to match: post_reel.py:22 is `sys.path.insert(0, os.path.expanduser("~/.claude/skills/ig-account-create/scripts"))` -- a HARDCODED absolute path to a specific OTHER directory (chosen precisely because cdp.py does NOT live alongside post_reel.py), not a `dirname(__file__)` pattern at all. behavioral-spec.md's own REQ-008 gets this right elsewhere ('post_reel.py imports it via `sys.path.insert` the same way it already imports ... cdp.py ... today' -- correctly implying a hardcoded path to reel_verify.py's actual directory), so the two spec documents now directly contradict each other on the concrete plumbing mechanism for the single most structurally important new file in this feature (the shared module all 4 pure functions live in, gated explicitly in the Phase 3 checklist: 'confirms the 4 pure functions genuinely live in one shared `reel_verify.py` module imported by both `post_reel.py` and the self-heal driver'). A builder following verification-architecture.md's literal text would write an import that raises `ModuleNotFoundError` the first time `post_reel.py` runs. This description has existed unchanged since iteration-5 (tagged '★ FIXED after iteration-5 FIND-010 ★') and was never re-verified against the real file locations in 7 subsequent iterations.

evidence.snippet: "both `post_reel.py` (via `sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))`-style import, matching its existing `cdp.py` import pattern)" -- contradicted by the REAL post_reel.py:22 (`sys.path.insert(0, os.path.expanduser("~/.claude/skills/ig-account-create/scripts"))`, a hardcoded path to a DIFFERENT directory than post_reel.py's own, not dirname(__file__)) and by reel_verify.py's stated location `~/anicca/skills/earn/clip/reel_verify.py` being a different directory tree than post_reel.py's `~/.claude/skills/ig-reels-poster/scripts/`
